annotations.title: Estimate what electricity plans would cost over a year

description: Use this when someone asks what electricity plans would cost them over a year, or which plan is cheapest for their usage across the seasons. Needs the user's usage: 12 monthly kWh figures from their bills (monthly_kwh), or an annual total (annual_kwh) that is spread over the months with the state's typical monthly profile; it never assumes a usage, so ask the user first. Returns up to 5 plans ranked by estimated annual cost (price only), each with its average cents per kWh. In Texas each month's bill comes from the plan's Electricity Facts Label (delivery included); elsewhere it is the supply rate plus the plan's monthly fee, set against the utility's price to compare. A Texas bill credit counts only in months at or above its threshold: the one the facts label states (credit_threshold_source efl or efl_twin), or an assumed one where we do not hold it (assumed). Plans shorter than 12 months are left out unless include_short_terms is true. Estimates, not quotes. Do not use it to sign anyone up, or to check one current rate against plans (use electricity_compare_my_plan). Plans that pay FindEnergyRates on enrollment are marked `referral: true`. This never affects ranking. `status` `no_data_for_scope` means our data does not cover that market right now, never that it has no plans.

annual_kwh.description: The user's total kWh for a year; spread over the months by the state profile.

detail.description: Add each plan's 12 monthly bills. Default false.

include_short_terms.description: Include plans under 12 months, priced as if they renewed at the same price for the rest of the year (each is marked). Default false.

monthly_kwh.description: The user's kWh for each month, January to December, from their bills. Give this, or annual_kwh, or usage_kwh.

term_months.description: Only plans of this contract length. Optional.

usage_kwh.description: One typical month's kWh; treated as 12 times that and spread the same way.

utility.description: The electric utility (in Texas, the delivery company), as electricity_list_utilities or electricity_find_utility_by_zip names it. Required.

name: electricity_estimate_annual_cost
